mechanism: Chlorpromazine may impair glucose metabolism and antagonize the glycemic control achieved by dapagliflozin, while dapagliflozin increases risk of euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis (eDKA) which may be masked by chlorpromazine's CNS effects.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely and watch for signs of eDKA (nausea, dyspnea, fatigue); consider alternative antipsychotic with less metabolic impact; educate patient on DKA symptoms that may not present with typical hyperglycemia.
